currentTwLabel: 營運產生之現金流入（流出）

note.zh-TW: 模板只寫「小計」，網站照教材顯示；IAS 7 釋例的名稱「營運產生之現金」列為別名，直接法版面的同一列共用這張名詞卡。
note.en: The template labels this line simply as subtotal, and the Chinese interface keeps that wording; the English interface uses the IAS 7 illustrative name, cash generated from operations, and keeps Subtotal as an alias. The direct-method line shares this card.

definition.zh-TW:
間接法營業活動的中途小計：稅前淨利加回折舊等非現金費用與利息費用、再調整營運資金變動之後，本業營運本身產生的現金。

它還沒扣掉利息與所得稅的付現；IAS 7 的釋例稱它為營運產生之現金。
definition.en:
The interim subtotal within operating activities under the indirect method: the cash generated by the business itself after adding depreciation and other non-cash expenses, as well as interest expense, back to profit before tax and adjusting for working capital.

Interest and income taxes paid have not yet been deducted; the IAS 7 illustrative example calls it cash generated from operations.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表營業活動區，營運資金變動之後、支付利息(-) 之前；直接法版面的同一列共用這張名詞卡。它應該等於直接法算出來的「向客戶收現減付給供應商與員工的現金」，網站用這個等式當核對。
example.en: Where it sits: operating activities in the statement of cash flows, after the working capital adjustments and before interest paid (-); the same line in the direct-method layout shares this card. It should equal the direct-method figure of cash received from customers less cash paid to suppliers and employees, which the site uses as a cross-check.

misconception.zh-TW: 把小計當成營業活動的現金流量總計。小計之後還要扣掉實際付的利息與所得稅，才是總計；兩者只有在沒有付息、沒有繳稅時才相等。
misconception.en: Mistaking the subtotal for net cash from operating activities. Interest and income taxes actually paid still have to be deducted to reach the total; the two are equal only when no interest or tax was paid.

formula.zh-TW: 小計 ＝ 稅前淨利 ＋ 折舊費用 ＋ 利息費用 ＋ 其他非現金損失 － 銷貨債權增加 － 存貨增加 ＋ 應收帳款減少 ＋ 應付帳款增加 ＋ 其他負債增加，也就是從稅前淨利到其他負債增加(+) 各列的合計（有延伸列時一併計入）。
formula.en: Cash generated from operations = profit before tax + depreciation + interest expense + other non-cash expenses and losses － increase in trade receivables － increase in inventories + decrease in trade receivables + increase in trade payables + increase in other operating liabilities, i.e. the sum of the lines from profit before tax to the increase in other operating liabilities (including any extension lines).
